status: post-opening held-out response-trait hypothesis frozen before validation readback
ecological_question: Does a species' baseline spatial breadth across route stops predict its later wet-versus-dry active-community response?
motivation: Conventional life-history functional distance did not predict rainfall-response similarity. A more proximal response trait may be the spatial breadth with which a species is acoustically active across local sites before the validation period.

trait_period_spatial_breadth.eligible_runs: same complete 10-stop, temperature-qualified NAAMP runs used in the ecological community analyses
trait_period_spatial_breadth.per_run_measure: for each species detected somewhere in a run, number of the 10 stops at which the species is detected divided by 10
trait_period_spatial_breadth.species_trait: mean per-run stop fraction across all early-period runs in which the species is route-present

validation_species_response.pairing: within 2008-2015 only; State x RouteNumber x RunNumber, adjacent observed years, equal-rain pairs removed, lower DaysSinceRain oriented wetter
validation_species_response.event: for each species present in exactly one member of a pair, y=1 if wet-only and y=0 if dry-only
validation_species_response.model: binomial-logit y ~ centered rain_contrast + centered temp_difference + centered doy_difference + centered year_gap with route-clustered covariance
validation_species_response.response: adjusted species intercept log odds and cluster-robust SE

primary_test.model: inverse-variance weighted least squares: late_adjusted_log_odds ~ z_early_spatial_breadth with HC3 covariance
primary_test.rationale: Species that are normally active at fewer stops are hypothesized to be more condition-limited and to show stronger recruitment into the active pool under recent-rain conditions; broadly active species should have less activation headroom.

prespecified_sensitivity.trait: mean fraction of active stops occupied by the species within early-period runs where it is present
prespecified_sensitivity.name: early_active_footprint_fraction

family_structure_sensitivity.method: 100000 permutations of late response labels within AmphiBIO family while early spatial breadth remains fixed

secondary_descriptives: Spearman correlation between early spatial breadth and late adjusted response
weighted mean late response in lower versus upper spatial-breadth tertiles
correlation of early spatial breadth with log body size among matched species
boundaries: Spatial breadth is acoustic stop use during surveys, not occupancy niche breadth or dispersal ability.
The trait is estimated in an earlier non-overlapping period and does not use validation outcomes.
A supported association would identify a proximal response trait but not rainfall causality or a physiological mechanism.
No alternative time split, breadth metric, threshold, or direction may replace the frozen specification after readback.
